architecture: character-level MLP language model, 8-character context (Bengio et al. 2003 style)
symbols_note: 96 symbols: index 0 is the newline, index 1 + k is chr(32 + k) for k = 0..94 (the printable ASCII characters, space to tilde)
padding: positions before the first character of a file are the newline (index 0); every file starts fresh
normalization_python:
def normalize(text):
    text = text.replace('
', '
').replace('', '
').replace('	', '    ')
    return ''.join(c for c in text if c == '
' or ' ' <= c <= '~')
forward: x = concat(emb[c1], ..., emb[c8]) for the eight previous characters, oldest first (128 values); h = tanh(hidden.weight @ x + hidden.bias); logits = out.weight @ h + out.bias; p(next) = softmax(logits). See FORWARD.md.
evaluation: mean bits per character, -log2 p(text[i] | text[i-8:i]), over every character of 33 Python 3 source files (about 220,500 characters) added to the CPython repository between August and November 2026: tests, build and inspection tools, a PEG parser generator's modules and library modules (not in the sandbox)
